title: Tax Graph Repeatable Table
description: A repeatable form table subunit: row-template columns plus totals rows, with taxpayer instances supplied at runtime.

table_id.description: Stable template-level table id, usually the IRS line anchor.

document_id.description: The document this repeatable table belongs to.

line_anchor.description: Human-readable IRS line anchor, e.g. 'Form 8949 Part II line 1'.

columns.description: Ordered row-template columns. Values in taxpayer facts are keyed by column_id.

totals.description: Totals-row nodes keyed by the row-template column they aggregate.

citation_refs.description: Ids of citation objects that authorize/explain this table.

gate.description: Orthogonal provenance axis: who stood at the promotion gate.

column_id.description: IRS column id such as d, e, g, or h.

kind.description: Whether the row-template column is supplied by facts or computed by rules.

template_node.description: Static node id for this row-template column.

column_id.description: Column id aggregated by this total.
